title: 버터 클레이
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: reusable 1024 by 1024 square seamless material tile for a football management game's controller background design proposal S1.
Primary request: Smooth handmade butter-yellow polymer clay, warm sunny pastel yellow, very subtle fingertip-scale material irregularity without actual fingerprints. Matte tactile modeling-clay finish, soft and even. No grain, no fibres, no bumps, no marbling, no gloss.
Composition: edge-to-edge uniform material, perfectly orthographic flat overhead macro, same tone and texture density at all four edges, seamless repeat, no vignette, no gradient or directional lighting, no obvious repeating geometric motif. Main colour approximately #f0cd67.
Constraints: texture stays subtle enough for small live interface text laid on top. Material alone, no screen mockup, no buttons, no icons, no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no logos, no frame, no border, no watermark.
